headlines.title: Voting Underway in Israel as Netanyahu Faces Battle for Survival
headlines.description: Voting began Tuesday morning across Israel in its first nationwide election since the Oct. 7 attacks of 2023, that is largely viewed as a referendum on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. NBC’s Richard Engel reports for TODAY from Tel Aviv on how the outcome will impact the United States, gas prices and the future of wars in the Middle East.

headlines.title: Grand jury declines to indict former Trump aide Cassidy Hutchinson, star witness of Jan. 6 committee
headlines.description: The failed indictment is one of many for federal prosecutors during the second Trump administration.

headlines.title: Alexander brothers, ex-luxury real estate brokers, sentenced to 30 years in prison for sex trafficking
headlines.description: Federal prosecutors were seeking life sentences for Oren, Alon and Tal Alexander.

headlines.title: Fed expected to hold interest rates steady as inflation tops midterm voters’ concerns
headlines.description: Officials believe there is plenty of time left to tackle inflation, allowing them to avoid making a move so close to an election.

headlines.title: White House tempers its tough talk on Canada trade as inflation tops voter concerns
headlines.description: Trump’s combative approach to Canada appears to be softening just days before midterm elections in which tariff-fueled inflation is a primary concern for voters.

headlines.title: Debbie Shields speaks out on her viral moment riffing with Conan O'Brien
headlines.description: Internet sensation Debbie Shields speaks with NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian about her recent viral video, where she stood out during an improvised conversation with Conan O'Brien on the popular internet talk show “Subway Takes.”

headlines.title: Judge berates DOJ attorney in court over new charge filed against former FBI officials
headlines.description: The judge tossed a new obstruction charge against Nikki Floris and Bradley Benavides and told the Justice Department attorney that “everything is a sideshow on top of a sideshow” in this case.

headlines.title: They bought cabins to live on a luxury cruise ship. High fuel costs got them kicked off in Cambodia.
headlines.description: A residential cruise ship halted operations in Cambodia on Tuesday amid soaring fuel costs, leaving passengers in limbo after the U.S. company that operates the vessel ordered them to disembark.

headlines.title: Oregon school shooter told police he was assaulted twice in recent years
headlines.description: Police reports describe incidents in recent years in which Griffin John II told police he was punched by a man who had been seeing his mom and hit by his friend’s sister.

headlines.title: California bill targets negligent pet boarding facilities after dog’s viral death
headlines.description: DJ Andrew Fedyk and his wife, Madeleine White Fedyk, posted about their dog, Dunkin, dying at a boarding and training establishment in the state.
